scope: Independent WebGL2 GPU geometry/normal/ray/density probes of the actual production liquid field, plus finite sign-symmetric probes of three extracted production Gaussian factors. Color and detached-drop hits are inert only to isolate carrier surfaces. Revision8 remains the frozen regression source for mode0/1. Center-filled upper mode2 criteria from revision8 are historical and do not apply to its new deliberately hollow bowl. These tests do not certify material naturalness, full multi-interface refraction, actual screenshot repeatability or Minecraft integration.
